item.blurb: Databuddy Analytics raises $560,000 pre-Seed and joins Y Combinator to launch AI platform for product analytics - Zawya. Databuddy Analytics raises $560,000 pre-Seed and joins Y Combinator to launch AI platform for product analytics  Zawya
WarpWare Raises $1.2M Pre-seed. WarpWare raises $1.2M in pre-seed funding to expand its AI-enabled engineering platform for spacecraft flight software and agentic workflows.
Arosa AI Raises $500K Seed. Arosa AI has raised $500K in seed funding led by Taryag Capital to support product development of its real estate research and planning platform.
XRlabs Raises $8.4M Seed. XRlabs raises $8.4 million in seed funding led by Playground Global to scale its AI-powered surgical co-pilot platform for operating rooms.
ScribeUp Raises $13M Series A. ScribeUp raises $13M in Series A funding led by Curql Collective to expand its AI-powered recurring bill management platform for financial institutions.

item.investors: Union Square Ventures, Khosla Ventures, and Homebrew
item.blurb: Tolan Raises $30M in Funding. Tolan raises $30M in a funding round with participation from Union Square Ventures, Khosla Ventures, and Homebrew for its AI companion app.
Aqar Exit Raises $200,000 Investment. Aqar Exit, an Egyptian proptech startup, raises $200,000 in a funding round at a $2 million valuation to expand its property contract transfer platform.
